abilities.description: When rolling defense dice, if Captain Artemis is adjacent to at least 2 other friendly figures with the Phalanx special power, add 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

abilities.title: HEARTBREAK RAGE
abilities.description: If you control Astinos and he is destroyed, Immediately place 2 wounds on this card and for the duration of the game add 1 to Captain Artemis's attack dice and Captain Artemis attacks an additional time.

notes: The text printed directly under the card name is the number '300' (no general symbol name printed). Custom card with Hasbro disclaimer text on left side.

abilities.title: DEMON COMMAND
abilities.description: After revealing an Order Marker on this card, instead of taking a turn with Babauligos you may take a turn with up to two differently named Demon Army Cards you control.

abilities.title: ACID BLOOD SLIME
abilities.description: When Babauligos receives a wound from a normal attack from an adjacent figure, all skulls rolled by Babauligos count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure.

name: STELIOS

abilities.title: RANGED CHALLENGE
abilities.description: If an opponent's non-adjacent figure attacks, it must choose Stelios to attack if possible. When rolling defense dice against this attack, one shield rolled will block all damage.

abilities.title: PHALANX
abilities.description: When rolling defense dice, if Stelios is adjacent to at least 2 other friendly figures with the Phalanx special power, add 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

notes: The number '300' is printed under the card name (appears to be a card/set number, not a general). Card art area is transparent. Fine print at left: 'Not endorsed by or associated with Hasbro or its affiliates. HEROSCAPE and all related characters are trademarks of Hasbro. ©2006 Hasbro. All Rights Reserved.'

abilities.title: HORDE MOVEMENT
abilities.description: You may move up to 12 Kobold Zombies you control each turn. However, you may only attack with 1 Kobold Zombie. You may attack with any Kobold Zombie you control, even if it did not move this turn.

abilities.title: ZOMBIES RISE AGAIN
abilities.description: If a Kobold Zombie that you control destroys an opponent's small Kobold, replace that figure immediately, if possible, with one of your own previously destroyed Kobold Zombies. Undead are not affected by Zombies Rise Again.

name: BLUE BEETLE

abilities.title: SCARAB ARMOR
abilities.description: Before taking a turn with Blue Beetle, you may remove any Scarab Markers on this Army Card and place any combination of Red, Blue, and/or Grey Scarab Markers on this Army Card. A maximum of 6 Scarab Markers can be placed on this card. Blue Beetle rolls one additional attack die for each Red Scarab Marker on this card, one additional defense die for each Blue Scarab Marker on this card, and adds 2 to his range for each Grey Scarab Marker on this card.

abilities.title: ADAPTIVE ATTACK
abilities.description: When Blue Beetle attacks, if there are no more than 4 Scarab Markers on this Army Card, he may attack one additional time.

notes: Custom DC-themed card; Scarab Marker tokens are shown around the card but are not part of the card itself.

name: MARRO DRUDGE

abilities.title: WATER STRENGTH
abilities.description: When a Marro Drudge is on a water space, add 1 to its attack and defense.

abilities.title: SWAMP WATER TUNNEL
abilities.description: If Marro Drudge ends its normal movement on a swamp water space, you may immediately place it on any empty same-level swamp water space within 5 spaces. If Marro Drudge is engaged when it starts to tunnel, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

abilities.title: DUAL WIELD
abilities.description: When a Marro Drudge attacks, it may attack one additional time. When making attacks with Dual Wield, subtract 1 from its attack dice.

notes: Custom card (CUC - Competitive Unit Congress); not official Hasbro product.

name: DILIOS

abilities.title: INSPIRING ORATOR
abilities.description: After revealing an order marker on any figure you control and before taking the turn, if Dilios has 1 or more wounds on his Army Card, you may remove Dilios from the battlefield and place up to 3 previously destroyed Einar squad figures you control on empty spaces adjacent to Einar figures you control.

abilities.title: PHALANX
abilities.description: When rolling defense dice, if Dilios is adjacent to at least 2 other friendly figures with the Phalanx special power, add 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

notes: The number '300' is printed under the card name (custom card number), not a general. Card art area is transparent/cut out. Fine print on left margin is a non-endorsement/copyright notice.

name: EMMA FROST

abilities.title: ALTERNATE FORM
abilities.description: Your army can only include Emma Frost (Diamond) if it also includes Emma Frost. Emma Frost (Diamond) never starts the game on the battlefield.

abilities.title: DIAMOND BODY
abilities.description: When rolling defense dice, if Emma Frost (Diamond) rolls at least one shield, the most wounds she may take for this attack is one.

abilities.title: MENTAL SHIELDING
abilities.description: Control of this Army Card may not be changed by any Special Power or glyph.

notes: Marvel-branded card; name header reads EMMA FROST with DIAMOND beneath.

name: BILL CIPHER

abilities.title: DREAM DEMON
abilities.description: Bill Cipher does not start the game on the battlefield. If Bill Cipher is in your army, after rolling initiative, choose an opponent's Army Card. You may look at all Order Markers on that card. After revealing an Order Marker on Bill Cipher, you may take a turn with any card Bill Cipher's figure is on.

abilities.title: POSSESSION
abilities.description: After revealing an Order Marker on this card, if Bill Cipher is on this card, choose an opponent's Unique Hero on the battlefield and roll the 20 sided die. On a roll of 11 or higher, remove all Order Markers from that card, place Bill Cipher's figure on that Hero's card and take control of that figure. Return Bill Cipher to this card if the chosen Hero is destroyed

abilities.title: THANKS FOR THE FAVOR, KID
abilities.description: If Bill Cipher is on a different Hero's card at the end of the round, return Bill Cipher to this card and return control of that Hero to the previous owner. That player adds 8 to their initiative roll in the next round, and that Hero cannot be chosen for Possession again this game.

notes: A "Gravity Falls" logo appears above the card name; no general/faction text is printed under the name. Small print at left of card: "Not endorsed by or associated with Hasbro or its affiliates. HEROSCAPE and all related characters are trademarks of Hasbro. ©2006 Hasbro. All Rights Reserved."

name: METHIS

abilities.title: TRADER
abilities.description: After moving and before attacking, choose a friendly Hero adjacent to Methis and place any Treasure Glyphs from this card onto that Hero's Army Card.

abilities.title: CRAFTSMAN
abilities.description: When you add Methis to your Army, choose up to 5 different Treasure Glyphs. You control those Glyphs but none start on the battlefield. Instead of taking a turn with Methis you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, place one of those Treasure Glyphs on this card.

notes: Custom/fan-made card; card art area is transparent. Power text says chosen Treasure Glyphs do not start on the battlefield, but Methis himself does.

name: FATE

abilities.title: TWIST OF
abilities.description: When FATE is targeted by an opposing figure after all dice are rolled, you may force your opponent to reroll any one die of your choosing. Ignore the previous result and keep the new result. Use this power only once each time FATE is targeted by an opposing figure.

abilities.title: CLIMB X3
abilities.description: When moving up or down levels of terrain FATE may triple its height.

notes: Card art shows dice; power title appears as 'TWIST OF' (likely reads with name as 'Twist of Fate').

abilities.title: WHISPERED SECRETS
abilities.description: After rolling for initiative but before anyone takes a turn, if Grima Wormtongue is within 6 clear sight spaces of both a Unique Hero you control and an opponent's Unique Hero, that opponent must show you all Order Markers on that hero's Army Card, and that hero subtracts 1 from its Attack and Defense values for the rest of this round.

abilities.title: BETRAYER 16
abilities.description: At the end of the round, if you control Grima Wormtongue you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 16 or higher, you must choose an opponent. That opponent now controls Grima Wormtongue. Give this Army Card to that opponent.

abilities.title: HIDDEN POWER
abilities.description: When rolling attack dice against any figure within attack range, count the number of spaces between Innaria and the figure she is attacking. Roll that many extra attack dice.

name: FUNIKO

abilities.title: PHANTOM RUN
abilities.description: Funiko can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement. Funiko does not have to stop her movement when entering water spaces.

abilities.title: CONCEALMENT 9
abilities.description: If Funiko is targeted and receives one or more wounds from an attacking figure who is not adjacent, you must roll the 20-sided die. Count the minimum number of spaces between Funiko and the attacker. Add this number to your die roll. If you roll a 9 or higher, ignore any wounds Funiko just received.

abilities.title: STEALTH BLADE SPECIAL ATTACK
abilities.description: Range 1. Attack 3. Funiko may only use Stealth Blade Special Attack if the defending figure was not adjacent to Funiko at the start of this turn. If Funiko inflicts a wound with Stealth Blade Special Attack, she may imediately move up to 4 spaces, as long as she ends this movement not adjacent to any enemy figures.

notes: Custom-style card; text transcribed as printed including the misspelling 'imediately'.

name: MERA

abilities.title: AQUATIC VAULT
abilities.description: Mera does not have to stop her movement when entering a water space. If, at any point during Mera's movement, she enters a water space Mera temporarily gains the special ability Flying for the rest of her turn.

abilities.title: AQUATIC CONTACT 2
abilities.description: If Mera is standing on a water space you may add 2 dice to her attack and 2 dice to her defense.

abilities.title: MAGIC: WATER SHIELDING
abilities.description: When rolling defense dice for Mera, as well as any figures that you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Mera, you may re-roll any dice that show a Skull once.

abilities.title: MAGIC: AQUAKINESIS SPECIAL ATTACK
abilities.description: Range 6. Attack 4. When using Magic: Aquakinesis Special Attack, if Mera is standing on a water space you may roll 6 attack dice instead of 4.

notes: DC logo at top; 'GCF' icon in first left-column slot above XEBELIAN; V2 1.0 printed below points box.

name: I.J.D. DRONES

abilities.title: INTRUDER ALERT
abilities.description: After taking a turn with the I.J.D. Drones, if at least one opponent's figure is within 6 clear sight spaces of at least one I.J.D. Drone you control, you may immediately take a turn with one Warden Hero you control.

abilities.title: TARGET SIGHTED
abilities.description: If an opponent's figure is within 6 clear sight spaces of at least one I.J.D. Drone you control, all Guard and Warden figures you control with a Range number of 4 or more may add 1 to their range when attacking that figure.

notes: FLYING power title printed with no description text. Two drone figure icons shown on right side of card.

name: MARRO MUTATION

abilities.title: CLONING DEFECT
abilities.description: Marro Mutations do not start the game on the battlefield. When rolling for the Water Clone special power of a Marro Warrior you control, if you a 1 or 2 you must immediately destroy that Marro Warrior and replace it, if possible, with one of your Marro Mutations that is not on the battlefield..

abilities.title: DOUBLE ATTACK
abilities.description: When a Marro Mutation attacks, it may attack one additional time.

notes: Custom/fan card. Text transcribed verbatim including apparent typos ('if you a 1 or 2', double period).

name: Lyssa Drak

abilities.title: YELLOW BATTERY 4
abilities.description: Start the game with 4 Yellow Battery markers on this card. Add one to Lyssa Drak's Move, Range, Attack and Defense numbers for each Yellow Battery marker on this card.

abilities.title: PROTECTIVE SHIELDING 4
abilities.description: Anytime Lyssa Drak, or any friendly figure or ITF within 4 clear sight spaces of Lyssa Drak is attacked and at least 1 skull is rolled, instead of rolling defense dice normally you may remove one Yellow Battery marker from this card and ignore that attack.

abilities.title: OMENS OF FUTURE EVENTS
abilities.description: After Lyssa Drak attacks place all dice that rolled a skull on this card.

abilities.title: BOOK OF PARALLAX
abilities.description: Before making an attack, if there are any dice on this card you must remove them and subtract the same number of dice from your attack. Automatically add a skull for each die that you remove from this card.

notes: Custom DC card; left column top slot shows a 'GCF' logo icon above Talokian. Version marking V2.1.0 near bottom.

name: ANT-MAN

abilities.title: PYM PARTICLES
abilities.description: After revealing an order marker on this card, and before taking a turn with Ant-Man, if Giant-Man is currently on the battlefield replace the Giant-Man figure with the Ant-Man figure, choosing one of the two spaces vacated by Giant-Man. Any wounds on Giant-Man's card remain on his card. If Giant-Man is destroyed Ant-Man is destroyed as well.

abilities.title: FLIT 2
abilities.description: When rolling defense dice 1 shield will block all damage. If Ant-Man takes no damage from the attack, you may immediately move him 2 spaces.

abilities.title: UNSEEN ATTACK
abilities.description: Figures attacked by Ant-Man cannot roll defense dice.

abilities.title: ANT-SWARM
abilities.description: After taking a turn with Ant-Man you may roll 1 attack die. If you roll a skull all opponent's figures adjacent to Ant-Man receive 1 point of unblockable damage.

abilities.title: GIANT-MAN
abilities.description: After drafting Ant-Man into your army you automatically receive Giant-Man at no additional cost.

notes: Custom Marvel card. Top left slot shows a 'GCF' logo instead of text. 'STEALTH' logo at bottom of text panel; version marking 'V2 1.0' below points box.

name: MERCHANT

abilities.title: WARES
abilities.description: Start the game with 3 symbol-side up Treasure Glyphs on this Army Card.

abilities.title: SURRENDER WARES
abilities.description: After this Merchant rolls defense dice against a normal attack from a Unique Hero figure, you may place a Treasure Glyph on the attacking hero's Army Card to ignore all wounds inflicted by that attack.

abilities.title: DELIVER WARES
abilities.description: After revealing an Order Marker on a Unique Hero figure you control that is adjacent to this Merchant, and before using any other special powers on any Army Card or Glyph and if there is at least 1 symbol-side up Treasure Glyph on this Army Card, you may first roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 6 or higher, you may reveal a Treasure Glyph and place it on the Army Card for that Hero.

notes: Custom card; 'Super Bogue' printed on right side. Disclaimer text printed at lower left.

abilities.title: NO QUARTER SPECIAL ATTACK
abilities.description: Range 2. Attack 2 + Special. After moving, Maggie Jones may attack up to four separate times. If Maggie inflicts at least two wounds on a single adjacent Unique Hero, you may target that figure for a second No Quarter Special Attack, adding an attack die for each wound marker on that figure's Army Card.

abilities.title: DISENGAGE
abilities.description: Maggie is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

name: GEDDY LEE

abilities.title: PRIME MOVER 12
abilities.description: Before taking a turn with Geddy Lee, roll the twenty-sided die. -If you roll 11 or less, take a turn with one other Precise Rock God you control. Add 2 to the Move, Range, Attack, and Defense of all Vydar Rock Gods who move this turn. -If you roll an 12 or higher, take a turn with two other Precise Rock Gods you control. Add 3 to the Move, Range, Attack, and Defense value of all Vydar Rock Gods who move this turn.

notes: Custom/fan-made card.

name: Nathaniel Teager

abilities.title: FIRST STRIKE
abilities.description: If you do not win initiative remove all order markers from this army card.

abilities.title: INVISIBILITY
abilities.description: Nathaniel Teager does not start the game on the board. After revealing an order marker on Nathaniel Teager you may declare an attack on any figure on the board. Place Nathaniel Teager adjacent to the targeted figure and roll the attack normally. Remove Nathaniel Teager from the board at the end of the round. You may continue using Invisibility until Nathaniel Teager is destroyed.

notes: Custom card. The text under the name is a stylized logo, partially obscured; it appears to read 'THE (1) FILE'.

name: SLAAD SPAWN

abilities.title: PARASITE
abilities.description: Slaad Spawns do not start the game on the battlefield. They are placed on the battlefield when Fubd'lub is wounded.

abilities.title: SPAWN SWARM
abilities.description: After revealing an order marker on a Slaad Spawn, you may take a turn with every Slaad Spawn you control.

notes: Custom card; disclaimer text printed on left margin.

name: SCARAB SWARM

abilities.title: THE QUEEN'S REVENGE
abilities.description: The Scarab Swarm does not start the game on the battlefield. Instead, place it on the Army Card of an Undead Queen you control. If she is destroyed, you may immediately place the Scarab Swarm on the space she previously occupied. Move all unrevealed Order Markers from that card to this card.

abilities.title: CREEPING FLESH-EATERS
abilities.description: When attacked by the Scarab Swarm, small and medium figures reduce their Defense number by X, where X is the remaining Life of this card. Soulborgs, Robots, and Constructs are not affected by Creeping Flesh-Eaters.

abilities.title: INSECT SWARM
abilities.description: For each wound marker on this card, reduce its Attack by 1.

abilities.title: CLIMB X3
abilities.description: When moving up or down levels of terrain, the Scarab Swarm may triple its height.

notes: Custom card; text at left reads 'Figure: D&D Rot Scarab Swarm'.

name: The Piper

abilities.title: March
abilities.description: Every friendly figure within 6 of this figure may move 1 additional hex.  Line of sight is not required for this ability.

abilities.title: The ladies from Hell
abilities.description: When an enemy figure becomes engaged with this figure or any friendly figure within 6 hexes, roll a d20.  On a roll of 8 or higher for squads or 15 or higher for heroes, the enemy figure must move back one hex and suffer a disengagement attack regardless of special ability.  Line of sight is not required for this ability.

abilities.title: Pick up the pipes
abilities.description: When the piper dies, a squad member who is adjacent to him may become the new piper with all of his abilities and stats.  Remove that squad member and place the piper where he was.

notes: Custom card. The number under the name is the general (EINAR).

name: TANK

abilities.title: CARRY
abilities.description: Before moving Tank, choose an unengaged small or medium figure adjacent to Tank. After you move Tank, place the chosen figure adjacent to Tank.

abilities.title: SLOW BUT STEADY
abilities.description: Whenever an Order Marker is revealed, you may immediately move Tank up to one space. When counting spaces for Tank's movement, elevation changes up to 4 levels count as one space. Tank may activate his other powers when moving due to Slow But Steady.

abilities.title: TOUGH SHELL
abilities.description: Tank never takes falling damage and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

notes: Custom card (My Little Pony logo, 'By: BurnyFlame' credit).

abilities.title: DIMENSIONAL ESCAPE
abilities.description: After defending against a normal or special attack, if Xvlthc did not roll any shields, place Xvlthc on any empty space within 2 spaces. Xvlthc will not take leaving engagement attacks when moving with Dimensional Escape.

abilities.title: ACCIDENTAL TETHER 10
abilities.description: Before moving Xvlthc or placing him with Dimensional Escape, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 10 or higher, you must choose another small or medium figure within 2 clear sight spaces of Xvlthc. After moving Xvlthc or placing him with Dimensional Escape, place the chosen figure within clear sight of Xvlthc on any empty space within 2 spaces. Figures moved with Accidental Tether will not take leaving engagement attacks.

name: WEREWOLF OZ

abilities.title: WOLF OUT
abilities.description: At the beginning of the game, do not place Werewolf Oz on the battlefield. Instead, when Oz is removed from the battlefield with the Full Moon special power, place Werewolf Oz on the space previously occupied by Oz.

abilities.title: HUNGRY LIKE THE WOLF
abilities.description: Werewolf Oz is considered to be engaged with all adjacent small or medium figures. Werewolf Oz cannot leave an engagement, and must attack every turn, if possible.

abilities.title: CHANGE BACK
abilities.description: At the end of the round, remove all wound markers from this card, and all Phase Markers and wound markers from the Army Card of Oz. Remove Werewolf Oz from the battlefield and place Oz on the space previously occupied by Werewolf Oz.

notes: Custom card; 'Figure: Pathfinder Werewolf' printed on left side. Not endorsed by or associated with Hasbro.

name: Uruk-hai Torchbearer

abilities.title: Fire Undoes Stone
abilities.description: After moving and instead of attacking, Uruk-hai Torchbearer may choose to use Fire Undoes Stone. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-4, all adjacent figures are safe. If you roll 5-16, each adjacent figure receives 2 wounds. If you roll 17-19, each adjacent figure receives 4 wounds. If you roll a 20, each adjacent figure receives 8 wounds. Fire Undoes Stone also affects destructible objects. After using this power, Uruk-hai Torchbearer is always destroyed.

notes: Custom-style card layout: the POINTS box (100) is printed at the top left rather than below DEFENSE. The banner across the middle reads 'Berserk Champion - Medium 5'.
